# Elf Destiny: vanilla buildings with an extra need for an elven good (Elven Crafts, Lembas, Mythril Elven Crafts). Key overrides of 00_market_district_buildings.txt.

high_street_market_1 = {
	type_icon = regular_buildings/high_street_market.dds
	next_building = high_street_market_2
	cost_gold = regular_building_cost_tier_1
	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	district_level_requirement = 4
	can_construct_potential = {
	}
	can_construct = {
	}
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
	}
	province_modifier = {
		monthly_commerce_tax = good_building_tax_tier_1
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_category_luxury_items_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
		trade_category_luxury_consumption_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}

	trade_good_need = { # Elf Destiny
		trade_good = trade_good_elven_crafts
		amount = luxury_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				commerce_tax_mult = 0.05
				prosperity_growth = low_prosperity_tier_1
			}
		}
	}
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_economic_terrain_modifier = yes
		modifier = {
			factor = 0.3
			province_size_level < 4
		}
		ai_general_building_modifier = yes
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_economical_building_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_merchant_attraction_category_modifier = { CATEGORY = trade_category_luxury_items }
		ai_merchant_attraction_category_modifier = { CATEGORY = trade_category_luxury_consumption }
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_urban_district_building_modifier = yes
		ai_capital_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_regular_new_building_modifier = yes
	}
}
